app.name: Spag AI Studio
app.tagline: AI voice agents for Nigerian businesses

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: We will email you a one-time sign-in link. No password needed.
login.sent: Check your email. If the address is valid, a sign-in link is on its way. It expires in 15 minutes.
login.devHint: Running locally? Open the fake inbox at http://localhost:8025, or look for the link in the terminal where the app is running.
login.devShortcut: Development shortcut: open your sign-in link directly. This button never appears on the live site.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
login.noOrganisation: Your account is not part of any organisation. Ask an admin to invite you.

verify.title: Finish signing in
verify.body: Click the button to finish signing in to Spag AI Studio.
verify.invalid: This sign-in link is not valid.
verify.used: This sign-in link has already been used.

dashboard.title: Welcome
dashboard.intro: Build an AI voice agent, test it, then run a call campaign.
dashboard.step1: Create an agent from a preset
dashboard.step2: Fill in your business details and check the lint score
dashboard.step3: Test it in the simulator (coming in M3)
dashboard.step4: Upload leads and start a campaign (coming in M4)

agents.title: Agents
agents.empty: No agents yet. Start from a preset.
agents.choosePresetIntro: Each preset is a ready-made agent you can edit. Guardrails are always included.
agents.deleteConfirm: Delete this agent? This cannot be undone.
agents.readOnly: You have view-only access. Ask an admin to change your role to edit agents.

business.intro: These details are filled into the prompt. Fields marked * are required.

blocks.intro: Your prompt follows the five-part framework. Edit, reorder, switch off or add blocks. Locked guardrails can be reworded but not removed.
blocks.lockedHelp: Always included. You can reword it, but not remove it.
blocks.title: Block title

parts.solution: Phase 2: Solution and what makes us different

firstMessage.intro: The first thing the agent says when the call connects. Ask only one question.

tools.intro: Actions the agent can take during a call. In this prototype, tools are simulated.

silence.intro: What happens when the caller goes quiet.
silence.endAfter: End the call after (seconds of silence)

voice.intro: Pick the voice for this agent. Voice previews arrive in M3. Only mock voices work for now.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.latencyOk: Length is fine for a voice call.
preview.latencyWarn: Getting long: replies may feel slow.
preview.latencyBad: Too long: replies will be slow.
